brief: 5 ways to kill self-doubt before it kills you.

slots.title: KILL YOUR SELF-DOUBT BEFORE IT KILLS YOU
NAME THE INNER CRITIC
slots.body: Self-doubt thrives in silence. Give your inner critic a ridiculous name to separate it from your true voice. Suddenly, its power fades.

slots.title: ACT BEFORE YOU'RE READY
slots.body: Confidence follows action, not the other way around. Take one small step while your brain is still making excuses. Motion creates proof.

slots.title: LOG YOUR WINS DAILY
slots.body: Your brain forgets evidence of your competence. Write down three micro-wins every evening. Soon, the data will outshine the doubt.

slots.title: CUT THE COMPARISON
slots.body: Comparison is a rigged game. Unfollow triggers, mute the noise, and run your own race. Your only rival is yesterday's version of you.

slots.title: MOVE TO RESET YOUR MIND
slots.body: Physical stress clears mental fog. A brisk walk or ten push-ups interrupts the spiral. Your body can override your anxious thoughts.

slots.title: BET ON YOUR FUTURE SELF
slots.body: Doubt is a terrible fortune-teller. Make one bold decision today that your future self will thank you for. Trust the compound effect.
